sentences.text: CORAM : ADVAIT M. SETHNA, J.

DATE : 14 AUGUST 2025 P. C. :
1.
Heard Mr Gadegaonkar, learned Advocate for the Applicants and the learned APP Mr Narwade for the Respondents/State.
2. This Application is listed for the first time today.
3. At the outset, learned Advocate for the Applicants would state that on page 18-A of the Application a wrongly typed copy of the FIR is annexed.
He seeks leave to replace the said pages.
Permission is granted.
Let the same be carried out.
4. Issue Notice to the Respondents, returnable on 08 September 2025.
The learned APP waives service of notice on behalf of Respondents/State.

Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, as the Applicants apprehend arrest.
The proceedings relate to Crime No.0419/2025.
The First Information Report ("FIR") has been lodged on 01 July, 2025 at 05:06 hours registered by the Udgir Gramin Police Station, District Latur.

entities.text: Udgir Gramin Police Station, District Latur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The occurrence of the offence is shown on 30 June 2025.
The offences alleged are under Sections 123, 274, 275, 223 and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
There are four accused persons in the FIR, out of which accused Nos2 and 3 are the Applicants in the present Application.

The informant is one Santosh Madhavrao Shinde,
aged 40 years.
6. With the assistance of the learned Advocates for the parties, I have perused the FIR and the record available with the Court.

7. This is an Application which relates to contraband i.e.
Gutkha which is banned substance under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
In this regard, several Anticipatory Bail Applications are pending before the Court where orders are passed by this Court.
8. It appears that the names of these Applicants/Accused are disclosed in the FIR.

They happen to be the owner of the alleged  1439.25aba  (3)
contraband.
The said contraband has been seized and there is no recovery to be done.
This is factually not controverted by the learned APP Mr Narwade.
It appears that, out of two vehicles involved in the alleged crime, one vehicle is yet to be seized.
It is stated that the Applicants do not have any criminal antecedents.

Learned Advocate for the Applicants would draw attention of the Court to the order passed by this Court in Anticipatory Bail Application No.1248/2025 on 23 July 2025, where the similarly placed Applicant has been protected by way of interim protection.
Such protection was on the basis of the order passed by this Court on 22 July 2025 in Anticipatory Bail Application No.857/2025 and connected proceedings concerning contraband i.e. Gutkha.
10. Considering the factual matrix as noted above, prima facie, in my view, the Applicants deserve some protection at this stage.

In view of the above, I pass the following order:
 ORDER (i) Until adjourned date of hearing, in the event of arrest of the Applicants in connection with C.R.
No.0419/2025 registered with Udgir Gramin Police Station, District Latur, for the offences punishable under Sections 123, 274, 275, 223 and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the Applicants are directed to be released on bail 1439.25aba on their furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) each with one or more sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicants shall attend the concerned Police Station on every Monday at 11.30 am, until further orders and shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) The Applicants shall furnish details of residential address and other contact details such as the mobile number etc. to the concerned Police Station.

(iv) The Applicants shall not leave the jurisdiction of the competent Court without prior permission,
until further orders.

(v) They shall not contact and/or influence the witness/es and/or tamper with the evidence in any manner whatsoever.
11. List this Application for further consideration/hearing alongwith Anticipatory Bail Application No.857/2025 and connected Anticipatory Bail Applications on 08 September 2025.
